Ready to earn good money and start a new job this week? PostNL Utrecht is looking for hard workers for our warehouse. Work hard, stay active, and make up to €29.98 per hour! You can start earning in just one week with a great team. Your hard work gets you great pay, and you stay moving all day. If you are ready to work, apply now and start earning!

What we offer
- Salary of € 14,99 per hour!
- Extra allowances of 20% and 30%
- 100% bonus on Sundays.
€ 29,98 per hour
- Travel expense reimbursement
- Growth opportunities
- Informal work atmosphere

Who you are
As a warehouse worker, you will be busy sorting packages. It’s important that you can handle physical work. You will also recognize yourself in the following:

- You speak the Dutch or English language;
- You’re available at least 3 days a week.
- You have your own transport to come to PostNL Utrecht
- You are able to lift parcels up to 20 kilograms
- You are directly available

What will you do
After clocking in, lacing up your safety shoes, and joining the team huddle for your daily station assignment, you’ll take charge of the conveyor belt. In this active, physical role, you will swiftly and accurately place packages of all shapes and sizes onto the belt at a steady, sharp pace to ensure everything gets sorted on time. If you are motivated, physically fit, and available to work Sunday through Friday from 5:00 p.m. to 2:30 a.m. You are exactly who we are looking for!

Where will you work
You have probably seen PostNL delivery drivers at your door. Now is your chance to see what happens behind the scenes! Step in as a warehouse worker and learn exactly how packages get from A to B.

Our team leaders are ready to show you how everything works. Want to step up? We offer training to help you become an (assistant) team leader. We also like to have fun together, like sharing a nice dinner or eating tasty 'oliebollen' during the holidays.

Come work with us at Sophialaan 7 in Utrecht!

Looking for a job in the area? Then we have something for you! PostNL Elst is looking for a warehouse employee in the morning shift. So you can enjoy a lot of free time as well! Earn up to €20,98 per hour. Check out the rest of the benefits.

What we offer
- Salary of € 14,99 per hour
- Travel allowance
- Only morningshifts
- Weekly payment
- a Saturday bonus of 40%
- Growth opportunities to (assistant) team leader

Who you are
Besides the fact that you have no problems getting up early and understanding and speaking the English language. You are also able to:

- available for minimum 3 to maximum 6 days
- apply for the VOG
- to come to the worklocation with your own transportation (bike, car, or scooter)

What will you do
As a warehouse employee, you are together with your colleagues, responsible for the stocking of the packages. But, what does this actually entail? Trucks arrive full of parcels. The idea is to get the roll containers with the parcels out of the trucks.  You put these in the right place. Then you, or one of your colleagues, stand there to feed the parcels onto a conveyor belt. You make sure that the package is checked properly. This is to prevent any malfunctions. Do you have questions about this or is something not working? There is always an assistant team leader around to help you.

- working hours from 05:30/07.00 till 12:00
- working days from Monday till Saturday

Where will you work
Together with your colleagues, you fulfill the function of a warehouse employee in Elst. The team consists of super nice and friendly colleagues from a specific target group. You can laugh very hard with everyone. But of course, we also work hard. A good combination that makes the time fly by!

- A job for a longer period with a permanent perspective
- Develop yourself as an (assistant) team leader
